name: Additional circuit-breaker pole
summary: An additional pole is a separately drawn part of a multipole circuit breaker.
description: An additional pole is a separately drawn part of a multipole circuit breaker. Parent and child representations retain a shared device identity while allowing the phase conductors to appear on separate schematic lines.
readingNotes: Verify common operation and the shared breaker tag across all poles.
